title: Open a placed component's source SchLib symbol
summary: A schematic right-click menu item, shown only over a component, that opens the component's source .SchLib and makes its symbol the library's current component.
phrasings: add an item to the schematic right-click menu
open the library a component came from
show a symbol in the schematic library editor
find the component under the mouse on right-click

commands.name: NavigateToSchLibComp
commands.description: Open the source .SchLib of a component on the current sheet and make its symbol the library's current component; returns the component, the library path and the read-back current component
commands.params: Designator=<designator, wins when given>|Component=popup|selected (default selected; the context menu item passes popup)|LibraryFolders=<folder>[;<folder>...] (then the sheet's folder and its Libraries subfolder are searched)

commands.name: ListSheetComponents
commands.description: Test helper: list designator, LibReference, SourceLibraryName and selection of the components on the current sheet

commands.name: CurrentLibraryComponent
commands.description: Test helper: report the current schematic document and, if it is a library, its current component
